messages:
Alex: Kicking off the green side cutover for router v5.3.0 now. Change window: 5m quiet window, ramp steps 5/10/20/40/100. Release notes: https://redwood.team/releases/v5.3.0

DeployBot: deploy-started: router-service v5.3.0 -> green pool. CID: db7a2f. Step=0 -> scheduled ramp.

InfraBot: health-checks: baseline latency p50=22ms, p95=120ms. Canary probes enabled (30s). Rolling out across us-east / eu-west / ap-south.

Marta: Suggest we use a clamp at 15% if 5xx > 0.5% for 1m or avg latency increase > 2x p95. Keeps small blast radius.

Jamal: Seeing a small error spike in eu-west after step=5%: 5xx ~0.4% -> trending up. Logs show `transport: connection reset by peer` on a subset of instances.

Priya: Can we pin sessions for eu-west to v5.2.9 for now? Session-affinity key is `session_id`. That avoids user pogo-sticking while we troubleshoot.

Alex: Good call. Doing immediate route pin for eu-west. Command: `rctl route bind router-prod eu-west --version v5.2.9`

DeployBot: route-update: eu-west pinned -> v5.2.9. Affected sessions: ~12k active.

Emily: Also recommend hold ramp at 10% globally until we validate ingress TLS renegotiation fix. I've got a quick patch to backport, but that'll take ~25m to build+smoke.

Marta: Okay, new plan: pause ramp at 10% (step 2) and run focused smoke on 10% users for 10m. Fail criteria: >0.5% 5xx OR p95 > 2x baseline. If fail -> rollback green to 0% and force drain.

Jamal: I can run an on-host trace collection and correlate with kernel messages. Will post results in ~5m.

InfraBot: metric-alert: eu-west 5xx reached 0.62% over last 60s. Threshold breached.

Alex: That's above our clamp. Initiating emergency clamp: setting green weight to 10% and locking further ramps. Command: `rctl traffic-set router-prod --green=10 --lock`

DeployBot: traffic-update: router-prod green=10% locked by Alex. Canary timers paused.

Priya: Since eu-west pinned to v5.2.9, verify that session cookies remain valid after the clamp. Anyone seeing session drops?

Jamal: Session cookies OK in eu-west. Traces show TLS handshake retries on 3 hosts that were serving green. Correlating with kernel `ENETRESET` events. Attaching logs snippet: 
```
[2024-11-02T12:34:20Z] host-12 router: transport: connection reset by peer (ENETRESET)
[2024-11-02T12:34:21Z] host-12 kernel: tx_queue_restart
```
Marta: That points at a load-balancer connection timeout mismatch. Emily, can you confirm LB keepalive and idle timeout values?

Emily: LB idle timeout currently 60s, keepalive 30s. I propose increase idle to 120s for green pool temporarily to reduce resets while we patch. Will update config and smoke.

DeployBot: config-change-request: lb-config update for green-pool (idle=120s). Pending approval.

Alex: Approving. Make the change and smoke against green=10% traffic. If errors drop below 0.2% within 5m, we can resume incremental ramps.

Emily: Applied lb-config change to green pool. Rolling config reload on green hosts.

InfraBot: smoke-result after config change: eu-west 5xx -> 0.18% over 3m, p95 back to 130ms.

Marta: Good signal. Resume plan: next step to 20% after 5m stable, keep 30s probe interval, and keep eu-west pinned until end of change window.

Alex: Agreed. Resuming ramp: `rctl traffic-set router-prod --green=20`

DeployBot: traffic-update: router-prod green=20%. Canary continues.

Priya: Reminder: we should add a release-note bullet: "LB keepalive tweak to mitigate TLS renegotiation resets in v5.3.0" so ops teams know why we changed LB config.

Alex: Will add to the release notes and changelog.

Jamal: Oncall will monitor eu-west for 30m. If 5xx goes above 0.5% again we rollback to 0% and launch a postmortem. I'm on it.

Marta: Action items: (1) Alex update changelog, (2) Emily monitor LB reload metrics, (3) Jamal collect traces and open incident if repeat, (4) Priya keep session pin until end-window.

Alex: Done. Changelog updated: https://redwood.team/releases/v5.3.0#notes (added LB keepalive note).

DeployBot: deploy-finished: initial canary sequence complete. Final green=20%.

Emily: Quick FYI — we'll schedule a follow-up to push a proper kernel workaround into the next patch release. For now, LB tweak is the mitigation.

Priya: :thumbsup: locking eu-west pin until 12:15 UTC.

Alex: Thanks all. Keeping this thread open for the 30m observation window. If no further anomalies, we'll complete cutover to 100% after the window. :white_check_mark:
